venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 8/12** Quiet open that flipped fast with a 20-guest One Trust reservation at 5:30pm ($321 subtotal — beer and easy snacks); 5 Meal Deals at the start of the night. Jayden's first official shift behind the bar — opened solo and handled the Happy Hour group well with MOD support. Lull around 7pm, then steady guest flow 8–10pm with groups joining for a drink or two; good table service from the bar team. Smooth last call, space clear just after midnight. Kitchen: one of the slower nights for food tickets; prepping for a busy weekend. Low: Long Picks (8 backup bags in Cabinet D). Comps $33.70 (Community Investor, Industry Love, Tasting, O4W). No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 8/12** Excellent Wednesday at +102% to target. Slow start, volume built by 7:30pm; first pop at 7:45pm with steady service to 9:15pm and again 9:45–11:15pm. Several 8+ groups, majority local repeat guests bringing out-of-towners; finished with a larger client-hosting group, dates, and regulars. Kitchen: Daniel excellent in his first solo night. Comps $50.80 / 1.9% (manager, resident, Neuhoff employee, investor, recovery). Maintenance: Taco Tuesday tap line pouring irregularly. 86: Rose; low: Miller High Life. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Rain and wind — Garden rained out
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 8/12** Rain and wind killed the Garden's usual Wednesday business — packed it up ~7:30pm ($503.67 Garden sales); Kim crushed side-work with the time she had. Steady night on the D&C floor ($7,871.54 PM) with a good number of early cuts; DC/AM did $826.62 on a chill day with only 2 IRDs. Banana Boyz in town tomorrow for the rooftop Banana Daiquiri party promoting Municipal Grand Savannah — hoping for clear weather. Kitchen: slow night, decent prep day; 911 on mango curd, preserved lemon paste, pastas, succotash, lil burgers. Maintenance: still awaiting update on Garden/kitchen outlets. Comps $245.50. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV 8/12 (Wed) — Seth / Steves MOD.** Busy night with a mild start ramping 7–10pm into nonstop table-turning off staggered 7pm and 9pm reservations; tables until last call, energy faded final hour. First seating heavy on enthusiasts going straight to dealer's choice, several requesting tiki-esque cocktails. Top sellers: Rosalie / Paper Wasp (tie), Cloudwalk. Door: chill steady flow, bar full at 7pm, short waitlist ahead of a big 9pm turn; slowed after 11pm. Guests included regulars Koba and Luke, Leo HB (Midnight Blue), Josh Renderos (Experimental Cocktail Club), and influencer Fuki photographing the Crossover Episode. Comps $185.96 (members, investors, DNLs). Retail $40. No-shows charged (2 no-shows). Incident note: several investors claiming membership had access issues — Seth flagged to Bridget. Entered by Sean.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Nice and warm, then got cold
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 8/12** Slow start that built to a full bar and waitlist — everyone got seated, with the rush landing in the last few hours of service. Couple of birthdays; guests praised Jazmine's service all night. Oscar ran the kitchen as a one-man army and got food out on time through the late push. A few hiccups with food reflected in comps ($113.40). All sales through the Marquee ($5,230, food $1,013); no Standing Room or event business. 86: crudo. No incidents; no-shows charged. Finished effectively at target (-0.1%).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 8/12** Huge night at +131% to target on the back of a Garden buyout ($6,705.42 event sales) stacked on a steady Marquee ($3,260.49). Marquee opened with two-tops and solos, built by 7pm, looked good by 8, tapered by 10 with a natural last call at 11:30. Devan handled the floor solo with bar-team assists; Sasha floated between the Garden event and Marquee. Kitchen rocked both event food and Marquee service — James trained Rasaan on event execution while keeping pace. Guests: 104 SevenRooms (38 reso / 66 walk-in). Improvement note: work to completion and resetting to zero. Maintenance: stairwell paint. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Pleasant; hot afternoon and evening, no rain
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 8/12** Beat target by 7.8% on a steady-slow day. Morning: peaceful open with hotel guests, a lunch pop aided by the food tour ($880; 49 guests) — Tia held it down. Evening: no big pops, tables and bar groups sitting through the night ($2,833; 81 guests); F&B friends visited. Sun Club very slow in the heat — only 3 mojitos, $65 (some event sales miscoded to Sun Club revenue center this morning; $941 event sales total). Hot Eye closed. Kitchen: smooth aside from one guest unimpressed with the stuffed peppers. First Wheel of Fortune prize given out; Jazmine (Hunter's partner) celebrated her birthday. Comps $197.55. No incidents.
